Back Sinner to win the match, utilizing his powerful flat groundstrokes to dictate baseline rallies.

The pick is Swiatek to win outright, relying on her superior court coverage and heavy topspin forehand to control the points.

Zverev has been dealing with a minor blister issue that seems to affect his movement to the forehand side. Bet on Medvedev to secure the victory in this tactical baseline battle.

Rybakina's first-serve percentage has dropped below 55% lately, which leaves her vulnerable against Gauff's aggressive returning. Take Gauff to win the match, wearing her opponent down with relentless defense and consistency.

Djokovic's vast experience and mental fortitude in indoor tournaments make him an incredibly tough opponent. The confident pick is Djokovic to win the match, dismantling his younger opponent with precise serving and tactical brilliance.
